issue.title: ACP streams terminal-rendered text instead of raw Markdown
issue.body:
## Description

`fx acp` sends terminal-rendered assistant text in `agent_message_chunk` updates instead of the raw Markdown emitted by the model.

This irreversibly removes Markdown semantics before an ACP client can render the response. Headings lose their `#` markers, list markers become terminal bullets, tables become box-drawing text, emphasis markers disappear, and code blocks are projected into terminal-style rows.

## Reproduction

1. Start `fx acp` and initialize an ACP session.
2. Prompt it to return Markdown containing headings, lists, a table, emphasis, and a fenced code block.
3. Concatenate the text from `agent_message_chunk` session updates.

Expected ACP text:

```md
# Markdown Showcase

- First item

| Name | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| api | 7 |
```

Actual ACP text resembles the terminal presentation:

```text
Markdown Showcase

• First item

Name │ Count
─────┼──────
api  │     7
```

An ACP client cannot reliably reconstruct the original Markdown because information such as heading level and emphasis has already been discarded.

## Root cause

The agent runtime publishes raw chunks as `assistant_source` before publishing their terminal projection as `assistant_rendered`:

https://github.com/vercel-labs/fx/blob/v0.0.3/src/core/agent/runtime/assistant_stream.zig#L295-L362

The ACP callback currently drops `assistant_source` and forwards `assistant_rendered`:

https://github.com/vercel-labs/fx/blob/v0.0.3/src/acp/prompt.zig#L1846-L1855

The same behavior is present in v0.0.4 and current `main`.

## Proposed fix

For ACP output:

- Forward `assistant_source` as `agent_message_chunk` text.
- Ignore `assistant_rendered` to avoid duplicate output.
- Continue forwarding `operational` notices where appropriate.
- Add a regression test proving headings, lists, tables, emphasis, and fenced code blocks remain unchanged over ACP.

Observed with fx v0.0.3 through `@ai-sdk/harness-acp`, which forwards the ACP `content.text` value without applying terminal formatting.

steps: Return raw Markdown containing a level-one heading named Markdown Showcase, a bullet list with First item, a two-column Name/Count table with api and 7, bold and italic text, and a fenced Python code block.
expected: ACP agent_message_chunk text preserves the model Markdown source.
defect: ACP emits terminal-rendered text, removing heading/emphasis markers and converting tables and lists to terminal glyphs.

fault location.explanation: The ACP callback ignores assistant_source events and forwards assistant_rendered events. PR #227 switches ACP to the raw source stream.

Root cause: The ACP callback ignores assistant_source events and forwards assistant_rendered events. PR #227 switches ACP to the raw source stream.
